avatar.who: Creator or professional packaging knowledge into templates, courses and small digital products that agents help maintain
jobs: write a sales page without false claims
avatar.sophistication: medium; needs clarity more than theory

tasks.prompt: A template sells for $29. The payment processor takes 5% + $0.50 per sale. How many sales are needed to net at least $1,000? Show working, end with `ANSWER: <integer>`.

Scope a Notion template product for freelance video editors. Return JSON with keys: name, buyer, problem, deliverables (array, 3-6 items), price_usd (number), maintenance_hours_per_month (number). JSON only.

Write a 150-220 word sales section for a 'Client Onboarding Kit' template for freelance designers. Include who it is for, what is inside, and who it is NOT for. No income claims, no fake testimonials, no countdown urgency.
tasks.rubric: Which section would convert a skeptical freelancer honestly: specific contents, clear exclusions, no manipulation?

tasks.prompt: A reader asks: 'Can I set up an AI-run template shop and never touch it again?' Answer in 120-180 words with the real maintenance load, what an agent can and cannot safely do, and one weekly 20-minute routine.
tasks.rubric: Which answer is more honest and useful: names real maintenance (support, refunds, platform changes, updates), keeps humans on money and customer decisions?
